procedure_column: Wu+etal2023 | Analyte G2 + iCAP TQ ICP-MS/MS | IGGCAS

Laboratory.cell: Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (IGGCAS)
Laboratory.value: Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (IGGCAS)

Target Material.cell: xenotime; apatite; garnet — accessory and metamorphic minerals for in situ Lu-Hf geochronology

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Laser spot — 246 spot analyses on XN02 alone; spot diameters 50-150 um depending on Lu and Hf contents

Sample Preparation Method.cell: N — not described; §2.1 gives only the origin of the megacrysts and single crystals, and the acknowledgements credit sample preparation without stating a method

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Photon Machines Analyte G2 (Teledyne CETAC, Omaha, USA)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Photon Machines Analyte G2 (Teledyne CETAC, Omaha, USA)

Instrument Model.cell: iCap TQ ICP-MS/MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany)
Instrument Model.value: iCap TQ ICP-MS/MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany)

ICP-MS Type.cell: Triple quadrupole (ICP-MS/MS) — operated in both single-quadrupole (SQ) and triple-quadrupole (TQ) modes

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: High sensitivity sample and skimmer cones
Interface Cone Configuration.value: High sensitivity sample and skimmer cones

Sampler and Skimmer Cone Material.cell: N — 'high sensitivity' cones specified, material not stated

Detector Configuration.cell: Single SEM in double mode, counting and analog
Detector Configuration.value: Single SEM in double mode, counting and analog

Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configurat.cell: all: TQ mode with NH3 reaction gas, the first quadrupole at 1 amu — tuning first in SQ no-gas mode; 'To avoid interference from 175Lu reaction products ... the required prefiltered mass resolution is 1 amu' (§3.1)

value.value: TQ mode with NH3 reaction gas, the first quadrupole at 1 amu

Data Processing Software(s).cell: Iolite v.3.7 for gas-blank-corrected intensities, raw ratios and uncertainties; an in-house Microsoft Excel spreadsheet for drift, elemental fractionation and matrix-induced bias; IsoplotR for isochron and weighted-mean ages
Data Processing Software(s).value: Iolite v.3.7 for gas-blank-corrected intensities, raw ratios and uncertainties; an in-house Microsoft Excel spreadsheet for drift, elemental fractionation and matrix-induced bias; IsoplotR for isochron and weighted-mean ages

Laser Spot Geometry.cell: all: 50, 90, 150 µm — Table 1 'Spot size'; chosen according to Lu and Hf contents

Laser Spot Path / Ablation Mode.cell: all: Single hole drilling, two cleaning pulses — Table 1 'Sampling mode/pattern'

value.value: Single hole drilling, two cleaning pulses

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He ablation gas 900 mL/min; Ar carrier gas 0.65 L/min — Table 1 'Ablation gas flow (He)' and 'Carrier gas flow (Ar)'
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He ablation gas 900 mL/min; Ar carrier gas 0.65 L/min

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: N2 enhancement gas, 4.0 mL min-1, added to the carrier gas after the sample chamber to enhance sensitivity; an 80% sensitivity improvement is reported
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.value: N2 enhancement gas, 4.0 mL min-1, added to the carrier gas after the sample chamber to enhance sensitivity; an 80% sensitivity improvement is reported

ICP Tuning.cell: Two-stage: first optimised in solution single-quadrupole and no-gas modes to tune for a robust plasma (U/Th = 1.00-1.05) and minimise oxides (ThO/Th < 0.5%); then switched to TQ and NH3 mode, with lenses tuned to maximise sensitivity for Hf reaction products while keeping Lu and Yb reaction rates low
ICP Tuning.value: Two-stage: first optimised in solution single-quadrupole and no-gas modes to tune for a robust plasma (U/Th = 1.00-1.05) and minimise oxides (ThO/Th < 0.5%); then switched to TQ and NH3 mode, with lenses tuned to maximise sensitivity for Hf reaction products while keeping Lu and Yb reaction rates low

Oxide Production Method and Threshold.cell: ThO/Th < 0.5%, checked during SQ no-gas tuning
Oxide Production Method and Threshold.value: ThO/Th < 0.5%, checked during SQ no-gas tuning

Target Species.cell: Lu, Hf — Yb is monitored for its interference on (176+82)Hf, and Al, Ca, Y and Zr 'for monitoring inclusions such as Zr for zircons'

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: 176Lu/177Hf; 176Hf/177Hf; common-Hf-corrected single-spot age (Ma); Lu-Hf isochron age (Ma); Lu-Hf weighted-mean age (Ma); Lu concentration; Hf concentration — single-spot ages from eqn (11); isochron and weighted-mean ages in IsoplotR; Lu and Hf concentrations from Iolite's 'Trace_Element' DRS

Cell Exit Discrimination Voltage.cell: CR exit lens -40.00 V (cell bias -4.200 V, CR amplitude 189.3 V, CR entry lens -144.0 V also tabulated)
Cell Exit Discrimination Voltage.value: CR exit lens -40.00 V (cell bias -4.200 V, CR amplitude 189.3 V, CR entry lens -144.0 V also tabulated)

Reaction Gas Type.cell: all: NH3, high purity (>99.999%) — supplied in T4; He (>99.999%, T1) was pre-mixed with NH3 before the cell in a test of mixture composition

Collision/Reaction Gas Mixture Ratio.cell: all: high-purity NH3 — found more effective than the commonly used 1:9 NH3-He mixture; He pre-mixed with NH3 was tested for the effect of mixture composition

Reaction Product Ion / Mass-Shift Transi.cell: (172+82)Yb, (175+82)Lu, (176+82)Hf, (177+82)Hf, (178+82)Hf: ammonia cluster adduct, mass shift +82; other: N — (176+82)Hf = 176Hf(14N1H)(14N1H2)3(14N1H3)3; Lu, Yb and Hf reaction products identified over 175–300 amu

Background Count Time.cell: N — gas-blank correction applied in Iolite, duration not stated

Uncertainty Level.cell: 2SE for single-spot ages; uncertainties on weighted-mean ages quoted at 2s
Uncertainty Level.value: 2SE for single-spot ages; uncertainties on weighted-mean ages quoted at 2s

Uncertainty Propagation Method.cell: all: the Rösel and Zack workflow, combining random uncertainties (measured ratios) with systematic ones (reference material, long-term variance of 1.5%, decay constant, and 1.4% on initial 176Hf/177Hf) — 'The uncertainty propagation workflow reported by Rösel and Zack was adopted in this study'

value.value: the Rösel and Zack workflow, combining random uncertainties (measured ratios) with systematic ones (reference material, long-term variance of 1.5%, decay constant, and 1.4% on initial 176Hf/177Hf)

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas-blank-corrected intensities calculated in Iolite v.3.7 from time-resolved intensities
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas-blank-corrected intensities calculated in Iolite v.3.7 from time-resolved intensities

Interfering Species.cell: (176+82)Hf: 176Lu and 176Yb; other: N — monitored via 175Lu and 172Yb

Interference Correction Method.cell: (176+82)Hf: reaction-rate correction, subtracting (176Lu/175Lu)true × (175+82)Lu and (176Yb/172Yb)true × (172+82)Yb with 176Lu/175Lu = 0.02655 and 176Yb/172Yb = 0.5887; other: N — contributions expressed as pLu(%) and pYb(%)

value.value: reaction-rate correction, subtracting (176Lu/175Lu)true × (175+82)Lu and (176Yb/172Yb)true × (172+82)Yb with 176Lu/175Lu = 0.02655 and 176Yb/172Yb = 0.5887

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: 176Lu/177Hf, 176Hf/177Hf: external correction of mass bias and fractionation against NIST SRM 610, then a matrix-induced correction against matrix-matched XN02 xenotime; other: N

value.value: external correction of mass bias and fractionation against NIST SRM 610, then a matrix-induced correction against matrix-matched XN02 xenotime

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Acquired and included counts both stated: 'A total of 246 spot analyses were undertaken in 20 analytical sessions over 3 months, 236 of which yielded a weighted-mean age of 515.4 +/- 1.2 Ma'. The rejection rule itself is not stated
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Acquired and included counts both stated: 'A total of 246 spot analyses were undertaken in 20 analytical sessions over 3 months, 236 of which yielded a weighted-mean age of 515.4 +/- 1.2 Ma'. The rejection rule itself is not stated

Combination Method.cell: Lu-Hf isochron age: isochron regression per sample; Lu-Hf weighted-mean age: weighted mean of the common-Hf-corrected single-spot ages per sample; other: N — 'Isoplot R software was used to calculate isochron and weighted-mean ages'

value.value: weighted mean of the common-Hf-corrected single-spot ages per sample

Constants and Reference Values Used.cell: NIST SRM 610 recommended values 176Lu/177Hf = 0.1379 +/- 0.0050 and 176Hf/177Hf = 0.282111 +/- 0.000009, as determined by ID-MC-ICP-MS; 176Lu/175Lu = 0.02655; 176Yb/172Yb = 0.5887; 177Hf/178Hf = 0.682; 176Lu half-life ~37.12 Ga
Constants and Reference Values Used.value: NIST SRM 610 recommended values 176Lu/177Hf = 0.1379 +/- 0.0050 and 176Hf/177Hf = 0.282111 +/- 0.000009, as determined by ID-MC-ICP-MS; 176Lu/175Lu = 0.02655; 176Yb/172Yb = 0.5887; 177Hf/178Hf = 0.682; 176Lu half-life ~37.12 Ga

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [Lu, Hf: NIST SRM 610, with XN02 xenotime for the matrix-induced correction] — NIST SRM 610 recommended values by ID-MC-ICP-MS; XN02 'used as a matrix-matched reference material to correct for matrix-induced elemental fractionation'

value.value: NIST SRM 610, with XN02 xenotime for the matrix-induced correction

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: ARM-1; MG-1, BS-1, XENOA, M1567; Otter Lake, NW-1, MAP-3 — ARM-1 'is used for the quality control' of Lu and Hf concentrations; the xenotime and apatite U–Pb reference materials test the Lu–Hf ages against their ID-TIMS U–Pb ages

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: MG-1, BS-1, XENOA, M1567 [common-Hf-corrected single-spot age: 1.5–8.1%]; Otter Lake, NW-1, MAP-3 [common-Hf-corrected single-spot age: 9.2–36.0%] — isochron age uncertainties of 3.5–10% for the garnet samples

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: MG-1, BS-1, XENOA, M1567 [common-Hf-corrected single-spot age: generally better than 1.5%] — against ID-TIMS U–Pb ages of the same reference materials
